title: Bout Agreement Basics
text: A bout agreement is valid only if: the fighter's name and signature match the file on record; the weight class matches the division on file; the purse matches the amount you agreed (see file card).

title: Licensed Managers Only
text: Fighter representatives must hold a current Athletic Commission license number. Unlicensed reps (dads, cousins, 'Glen from the gym') cannot sign on a fighter's behalf.

title: Exclusivity Clause
text: Every bout agreement must include the standard exclusivity clause. No clause, no fight. Lawyers love loopholes.

title: Pre-Fight Medicals
text: Medical clearances must be signed by a licensed physician from the Commission registry and must not be expired on fight night. Required scans are listed below.

title: KO Suspensions
text: A fighter on medical suspension (after a KO/TKO loss) cannot be cleared or booked until the suspension date has passed.

title: Weigh-In Tolerance
text: Non-title fighters may weigh up to the tolerance above the division limit. Title fights: on the limit or under. Anything over is a missed weight.

title: Sponsor Exclusivity
text: A fighter may not wear two competing sponsors in the same category. Check the sponsor already on file before approving a new patch.

title: Camp Expense Reimbursement
text: We reimburse reasonable camp expenses. Each line item must be under the per-item cap and the total must match the sum of the items. Receipts with obviously fake items are to be denied.

title: Anti-Doping Program
announce: PROMOTION LAUNCHES 'COMPREHENSIVE' ANTI-DOPING PROGRAM; FIGHTERS ASK WHAT 'COMPREHENSIVE' MEANS
text: All fighters are subject to testing. Any substance code on the banned list is a failure unless an approved Therapeutic Use Exemption (TUE) is attached. Metabolites below the picogram threshold are considered environmental contamination.

title: Whereabouts Failures
text: Three missed whereabouts filings in 12 months counts as a failed test. Fighters at two strikes must be flagged (ESCALATE).

title: Press Credentials
announce: PROMOTION TO 'REVIEW' MEDIA CREDENTIALS; REPORTERS NERVOUSLY CHECK LANYARDS
text: Credentials must be issued by a recognized outlet and must not belong to a reporter on the banned list. Photo on credential must match the person in your window.

title: Court Date Conflicts
text: A fighter cannot be booked on a card that falls on or after a scheduled court date in the same week. Fighters with no-travel orders cannot fight outside their home region.

title: Mandatory MRI
announce: COMMISSION ORDERS MANDATORY MRIs AFTER FIGHTER'S BRAIN DESCRIBED AS 'VIBES-BASED'
text: All medicals must now include a current MRI.

title: Zero Tolerance Weigh-Ins
announce: ATHLETIC COMMISSION TIGHTENS WEIGH-IN RULES; ONE-POUND ALLOWANCE ABOLISHED
text: The one pound allowance is gone. Every fighter must weigh in at or under the division limit.

title: Work Visas
announce: INTERNATIONAL EXPANSION: FIGHTERS NOW NEED WORK VISAS, PASSPORTS, AND A LAWYER
text: International events require a valid work visa. Passport must not expire before the event date. Some countries deny entry to anyone with a listed arrest.

title: Eye Exams
text: After a fighter fought with one eye for two rounds, an ophthalmology exam is now required.

title: New Picogram Thresholds
announce: ANTI-DOPING AGENCY CUTS PICOGRAM THRESHOLD IN HALF; NUTRITION SUPPLEMENT INDUSTRY IN SHAMBLES
text: The picogram threshold for metabolites is halved.

title: Betting Sponsor Ban
announce: REGULATORS BAN BETTING SPONSORS FROM FIGHT SHORTS; BOOKIES DEVASTATED, BRIEFLY
text: Betting companies can no longer appear on fighter kits.

title: Crypto Sponsor Freeze
announce: AFTER THIRD RUGPULL, LEAGUE BANS CRYPTO SPONSORS; MOON NOT REACHED
text: Crypto exchanges and coins are banned sponsor categories.

title: Shorter Medical Validity
text: Medical clearances are now valid for 13 weeks instead of 26.

title: Expense Crackdown
announce: NEW OWNERS AUDIT CAMP EXPENSES; 'WHY IS THERE A JET SKI?'
text: The per-item cap is cut and luxury items are banned outright.
